column3: “Sick to die” is rendered “mortally ill,” and “command to your household” as “Set your house in order.”
“Faithfulness” is rendered “truth,” and “complete heart” as “whole heart.”
The written Hebrew reads “the middle city,” the reading tradition “the middle court”; NASB follows the latter.
“To your days” is rendered “to your life.”
The Hebrew “the shadow has gone ten steps” is rendered as a question (“shall the shadow go forward ten steps”).
The Hebrew spells the name “Berodach-baladan,” as NASB does (Isa 39:1 has “Merodach”). NASB renders “a son of Baladan.”
“Listened to them” is kept; many manuscripts read “was glad over them.” “Oil of the good” is rendered “precious oil,” and “house of his weapons” as “house of his armor.”
“He said” is rendered “he thought,” and “stability” as “truth.”
